message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live weather data. I can give you a general idea of San Francisco’s climate, but for the current conditions you’ll want to check a reliable weather service (e.g., the National Weather Service, Weather.com, or a weather app).

**Typical San Francisco weather (average):**

| Season | Avg. High | Avg. Low | Notes |
|--------|-----------|----------|-------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | ~12 °C (54 °F) | ~7 °C (45 °F) | Mild, often cloudy, occasional fog |
| Spring (Mar–May) | ~15 °C (59 °F) | ~9 °C (48 °F) | Gradually warming, still cool evenings |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | ~20 °C (68 °F) | ~13 °C (55 °F) | Warm days, cooler nights, frequent fog in the mornings |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | ~18 °C (64 °F) | ~12 °C (54 °F) | Pleasant, decreasing fog |

If you’d like the current temperature, humidity, wind speed, or forecast, let me know and I can guide you on how to retrieve that information from a weather API or website.
